Shadow writes:

"I think if a good anarchist punk band
wrote a song about him, he'd like it!"

TK once wrote:

	ï¿½Art forms that appeal to modern 
leftist intellectuals tend to focus
on sordidness, defeat and despair, or 
else they take an orgiastic tone,
throwing off rational control as if 
there were no hope of accomplishing
anything through rational calculation 
and all that was left was to  immerse oneself in the sensations of the moment.ï¿½
